fact: Completed a practice start before taking the end of session signal.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code, non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 10, document 3).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz), team representative and reviewed positioning data, team radio and video. Car 55 performed a practice start in violation of the Race Director's Event Notes, which only permit a practice start once the car has crossed the Line. Car 55 had not crossed the line, and while the Stewards recognized that the situation ahead of him was confusing, consistent with prior decisions, they issue a Reprimand (Driving).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions
